nam_sqrt5_over_4.applies: Nam text: alpha_N >= sqrt(5)/4 when N>=3 (s=2)

equilateral_centred_s2.note: configuration, hence an upper bound on inf alpha_3

tetrahedron_centred_s2.note: Regular tetrahedron centred at the origin. Evaluates alpha_4,2 exactly. So alpha_4,2 <= sqrt(6)/4 < 2/3, and alpha_4,2 * 3 <= 3*sqrt(6)/4 < 2. The s=2 pair geometry cannot exclude N=4 at Z=2 even if the kinetic remainder is dropped. Independent integer check: 9*6 = 54 < 64.

note: Published elementary lowers on alpha_4 stop at 1/2 or at sqrt(5)/4. The tetrahedron gives a certified *upper* on alpha_4,2 below the 2/3 threshold. No geometric dent for Nc(2)<4 from the |x|^s pair ratio.
